name: rush_hour_benchmark_900_4_12
description: Rush Hour Benchmark 900 (4_12) is a collection of Rush Hour sliding-block puzzle instances intended to evaluate planning and RL agents on combinatorial puzzle solving. It measures an agent's ability to find valid solutions under constraints, typically assessing success, solution length, and efficiency across 900 problems. The suite is used to compare planning/learning approaches on hard discrete search tasks.
reputation: A specialized RL/planning benchmark used within the MultiRL community; limited mainstream adoption.
